141-728-3085.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-728-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-789-2464-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-789-2464-3249--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-789-2464-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Gutter Grime triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for {0} that dies on enter

1957-2530-3641--203.easyPrerequisites: You either have at least 2 life or {B} available.
1957-2530-3641--203.description:
Cast the creature card from your hand for {0}. The creature enters, then immediately dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the creature enters, Carnival of Souls and Distinguished Conjurer trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls ability, adding {B} and losing 1 life.
Resolve the Distinguished Conjurer ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

967-3809-4772-7087-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

252-1322-4231-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-1322-4231-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1417-2738-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Bridge from Below, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Tenacious Dead enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2060-2232-7889.notablePrerequisites:
You have a nonartifact creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana with the mana to cast it.
You control and own another nontoken nonartifact creature that can be cast using only colored mana.
2060-2232-7889.description:
Cast the nonartifact creature in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the creature spell. When it enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the other creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 4 until you run out of +1/+1 counters, or you have enough mana to cast the creature that was returned to your hand.
Repeat from step 1.
2060-2232-7889.notes: If the creature that starts on the battlefield has a higher mana value than the creature in your hand, you'll need to provide extra mana to cover the difference to start. So if the creature in your hand has a mana value of 3 and the creature on the battlefield has a mana value of 5, you need {2} extra to start.

215-5709-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-5709-6965.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

6723-6968-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6723-6968-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6723-6968-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

745-2523-2869.description:
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Mirrorhall Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mirrorhall Mimic dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Mirrorhall Mimic that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Mirrorhall Mimic token instead.
745-2523-2869.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

224-2157-3875-6973.notablePrerequisites: Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
224-2157-3875-6973.description:
Cast Mutable Explorer by paying {2}{G}.
When Mutable Explorer enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Mutavault land token.
When the Mutavault token enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Reoslve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Mutavault token.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2292-5058-7422.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1765-2440-4742-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1765-2440-4742-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

4316-5078-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat

4976-6798-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4976-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Open the Graves and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

5800-7117.description:
Cast Invulnerability with buyback by paying {0} due to Aang's cost reduction, returning Invulnerability to your hand.
Repeat.

579-1115-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-1115-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

141-1532-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1532-4050.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-5256-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5256-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

147-5147-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5147-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5147-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

1268-3053-3918.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four basic land types among lands you control
1268-3053-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {3}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

586-5011-5406-6797.description:
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Priest of Gix and causing Priest of Gix to become a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

643-5365-5641-6725.description:
Activate Sophia by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact token.
If the token was a Clue, Lonis's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Sophia ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Lonis's first ability and Basking Broodscale trigger, creating a Clue token and a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
643-5365-5641-6725.notes: The +1/+1 counter in step 2 can be placed on any creature except Lonis - this includes Basking Broodscale for infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens

2724-3217-6433.description:
Activate Flickerform by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling Wormfang Manta and all Auras attached to it.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Flickerform triggers, returning Wormfang Manta from exile to the battlefield, and then returning all Auras that were attached to Wormfang Manta from exile to the battlefield attached to Wormfang Manta.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

2933-4013-4772.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1496-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
1496-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

803-843-1558-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Lin Sivvi does not have summoning sickness.
"Rebel" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-843-1558-4840.description:
Activate Lin Sivvi's first ability by paying {7} and tapping it, causing you to search your library for Myr Battlesphere and put it onto the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lin Sivvi's second ability by paying {3}, putting Myr Battlesphere on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

2281-2757-3604.description:
Cast Saffi Eriksdotter by paying {G}{W}.
When Saffi Eriksdotter enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Saffi Eriksdotter, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Saffi Eriksdotter.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saffi Eriksdotter token, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate the Saffi Eriksdotter token by sacrificing it, targeting the nontoken Saffi Eriksdotter.
Activate Saffi Eriksdotter by sacrificing it, targeting Cadric.
When the nontoken Saffi Eriksdotter dies, the token Saffi Eriksdotter triggers, returning the nontoken Saffi Eriksdotter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

81-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Kami of Whispered Hopes does not have summoning sickness, and has power 4 or greater.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kami of Whispered Hopes
81-5200.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes
Repeat.
81-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1994-3840-3858.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander on the battlefield.
Eldrazi Conscription attached to your commander.
1994-3840-3858.description: At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

1475-4050-4955.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Grafted Wargear attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
1475-4050-4955.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Grafted Wargear attached, adding one mana of any color.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

447-776-1329-4534.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
447-776-1329-4534.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Gustha's Scepter to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Gustha's Scepter.
Cast Gustha's Scepter.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
